notes.title: SEA EXPLORER OPEN TESTING!
notes.content:
Finally, [b]Sea Explorer 1.0 [/b] release is here!

During first weeks, the game will be aviable at the Steam Store, for balancing issues. As a open BetaTest! If want to participate in the evolution and gameplay fixes of the game, now you can!

This game has been made by only 1 person!
If you are a 3D artist and want to collaborate creating some 3D model for the game, contact!
If you have any brilliant idea for a minigame, contact!
If you arelooking for a collaboration in a new videogame, and/or have good 2D/3D artist, contact!

For any suggestion, sensation, bug reporting, also contact!

Use armagedoomgamesstudio@gmail.com

:D

Thanks in advance to everybody and enjoy!
